question: N11에서 중요군별 승인 독립 FINAL이 10개에 못 미치면 어떻게 처리할까요? (결과 관측 전 사전 규칙)
source: direct human answer in this Claude Code conversation (AskUserQuestion)
rule: Before any new FINAL dispatch, every important group (CODE/WHY/POLICY/TRACE/ABS) with fewer than 10 approved independent FINAL clusters is fixed as descriptive/inconclusive. Such groups yield no default-on or release claim. Groups that reach 10 are evaluated with the existing thresholds. Expanding a group later requires a new pre-result review.

consistent_with_existing_protocol_field.small_group_policy: n<10 independent final questions in an important group => descriptive/inconclusive; no default-on or release claim. Expansion requires new pre-result review.

consequence: N11 completion no longer waits for 10 clusters per group; it still needs individual human adjudication of the clusters that are used, protocol/source/model/runtime freeze, and bound evidence. With all groups currently below 10, any run would be descriptive/inconclusive for every group, and N08/N09/N10 quality verdicts could not support default-on in N18.
